The '''16th Assembly of Kerala''' is elected in the [[2026 Kerala Legislative Assembly election]]. The Speaker is [[Thiruvanchoor Radhakrishnan]] of [[Indian National Congress|INC]]. The Deputy Speaker is [[Shanimol Osman]] of [[Indian National Congress|INC]]. The Leader of the Assembly is [[V. D. Satheesan]] from [[Indian National Congress|INC]]. The Leader of Opposition is [[Pinarayi Vijayan]] of [[Communist Party of India (Marxist)|CPI(M)]]. The Government Chief Whip is [[Apu John Joseph]] of [[Kerala Congress]].
